tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The sheet. Everything sits on it; the only background the page has.

tokens.name: desk
tokens.usage: Browser only: the grey desk behind the centred sheet. Never printed.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, checkboxes, the masthead and section rules. 21:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: The grey context line under tasks, source tags, imprint, motto, footer meta, 'unavailable' lines. 7.0:1 on paper; flattens to ink on e-ink.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Masthead rule, section and rubric rules, insight and lesson borders.

tokens.name: rule-light
tokens.usage: Secondary rules only: the column divider, the tasks divider, the QR strip. 3.3:1 on paper; never under text.

styles.name: masthead-date
styles.usage: 50 pt. The day number, on the nameplate baseline and no taller than the nameplate. Lining, proportional figures, −0.02 em tracking.

styles.name: masthead-month
styles.usage: 21.975 pt. Month name beside the day number.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: 18 pt. 'Ranica' in the masthead, right-aligned.

styles.name: weather-number
styles.usage: 42 pt. Today's maximum temperature. Minimum 36 pt in any reflow.

styles.name: word-of-day
styles.usage: 18 pt. Back page: the word of the day, gloss inline after it.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: 10.5 pt. News item titles (≤ 70 characters).
styles.sample: Kotlin 2.4 ships with faster incremental compilation

styles.name: body
styles.usage: 9.375 pt. Body text: summaries, weather sentence, lesson lines, event meta, sport line. Justified or left only; never centred.
styles.sample: Morning +2°, feels like −3°. Cloudy, dry, wind 5 m/s.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: 9.375 pt. Event and task titles, German words in the lesson, the weather advice line.
styles.sample: Colder than it looks. Take a hat.

styles.name: insight
styles.usage: 9.975 pt. Text inside the insight box; one step above body.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: 7.875 pt. The grey context line under a task or event, in ink-muted. Never below 7.9 pt.

styles.name: example
styles.usage: 7.875 pt. Example sentences in the lesson box; italic.

styles.name: unavailable
styles.usage: 9.375 pt. The one-line 'unavailable' note, italic in ink-muted, reason in sans after it.

styles.name: longread-title
styles.usage: 12 pt. Back page: in-depth item titles.

styles.name: table-value
styles.usage: 7.875 pt. Back page tables: cell values; numbers in sans weight 500, tabular (time style).

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: 7.5 pt. Section and rubric labels: uppercase, 0.12 em tracking, hanging under a rule. Also the masthead edition title and table column headers (0.06 em).

styles.name: time
styles.usage: 9.375 pt. Times in the agenda, tabular figures, 12 mm column.

styles.name: sun-line
styles.usage: 8.625 pt. The almanac line under the masthead and the weekday line beside the date (uppercase there).

styles.name: source-tag
styles.usage: 7.2 pt. Source tag after a news item, uppercase, 0.06 em tracking, ink-muted. Also the gloss in the lesson. Never smaller: 7.2 pt is the page floor.

styles.name: imprint
styles.usage: 7.5 pt. Masthead imprint line and footer: 'Issue №12 · Print run: 1 copy · Berlin'.

styles.name: qr-label
styles.usage: 6.975 pt. Label under a QR code (7 pt, the absolute floor).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: 1 mm. Label to content, note to its item, checkbox padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: 2 mm. Below the masthead rule, inside the lesson and QR strip, run-in lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: 3 mm. Between sections and rubrics, insight box padding, weather number to text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: 4 mm. Above the insight box and footer, lesson grid column gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: 5 mm. The column gutter (each side of the divider gets 5 mm).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: 6 mm. Phone padding; reserved for the comic slot gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: 12 mm. Page margin on all four sides of the A4 sheet.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: The only radius. Nothing on the page is rounded: boxes, checkboxes, QR codes and rules are square.

rule.note: Line weights in pt. Nothing thinner than 0.4 pt: hairlines below 0.3 pt vanish on laser printers and e-ink.

tokens.name: rule-hair
tokens.usage: Column divider, under the sun line (top), lesson bottom, tasks divider, QR strip top. In rule-light where secondary.

tokens.name: rule-thin
tokens.usage: Section and rubric labels (rule above), sun line bottom, footer top, checkbox border.

tokens.name: rule-medium
tokens.usage: Insight box border, lesson box top, word-of-the-day top.

tokens.name: rule-heavy
tokens.usage: The masthead rule, once per page, paired with the 0.5 pt rule under the sun line.

page.note: Print geometry. The template reads these as CSS variables.

tokens.name: page-width
tokens.usage: A4 portrait width. Letter variant later (216 mm).

tokens.name: page-height
tokens.usage: A4 portrait height.

tokens.name: page-margin
tokens.usage: All four sides. Content area 186 × 273 mm.

tokens.name: column-gutter
tokens.usage: Each side of the 0.5 pt column divider; 10 mm between text blocks.

tokens.name: column-split
tokens.usage: Left 62 % (weather, today, sport, lesson), right 38 % (news, insight, hobby, quote).

tokens.name: checkbox-size
tokens.usage: Task checkbox, 0.75 pt border, square.

tokens.name: qr-size
tokens.usage: Minimum QR code side, print only; one per rubric in the strip at the foot of the news column.

tokens.name: comic-panel
tokens.usage: Reserved: three 55 × 55 mm panels at the foot of the page, not rendered in v1.

tokens.name: kindle-page
tokens.usage: 6.8-inch e-reader PDF, grey-scale, single column.

tokens.name: eink-widget
tokens.usage: 1-bit display widget: date, sun line, weather, agenda (max 5), three headlines.
